method: Owner-approved native 8x reference + concept + approved pilot; built-in GPT Image latest exposed; native-size fixed-palette reduction. Raw/reference images in /tmp only.

s1-hud.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the FIRST input native game image as MICA, the ORIGINAL female pangolin in the second input concept sheet. Third and fourth images are owner-approved MICA pixel-art style anchors. This is a NEW drawing, never recolour: no hedgehog quills, no Sonic face. Jade overlapping round leaf-shaped scales forming a hood, cream long pangolin muzzle, small rounded coral inner ears, expressive brown eyes with lashes. Use clean chunky 16-bit pixel clusters, deep brown ink, teal/jade ramps, cream face and white highlights. Match FIRST image composition, facing, camera, silhouette placement and canvas aspect exactly; use full canvas, no added padding, no text. Transparent background. No checkerboard. Crisp readable at final native dimensions. Asset s1-hud, final 16x16 HUD/one-up face: head only, facing right as native, compact rounded scaled hood behind eye and projecting cream snout. Prioritize big clear eye and smile.
s1-hud.reduction: alpha>=128 bounding box; Lanczos to native composition rectangle; nearest fixed palette; inside one-pixel outline; portrait mapping mask

s1-spin1.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw FIRST native 8x pose reference as MICA the original female pangolin from SECOND concept sheet; THIRD and FOURTH approved pixel-art style anchors. New drawing, no recolour, no Sonic quills or blue hedgehog features. Rounded overlapping jade leaf-scale hood, long cream snout, small round coral inner ears, bright brown eyes/lashes, white gloves, coral hiking boots. Clean chunky 16-bit pixel clusters with strong dark ink and jade highlights. Transparent canvas, no padding, no checkerboard, no text. Final native 32x32 turning sign character plane s1-spin1. FIRST native reference is an intermediate spin sign frame with a checker/wipe of old faces: reinterpret its compressed portrait composition as MICA turning in perspective. Draw ONLY the character portrait inside panel; OMIT metal frame, pole and colored background as separate unchanged planes already exist. Head and raised white two-finger peace glove, wide friendly eyes, hood above and cream muzzle below. Project horizontally compressed bust into interior panel x5..25 y3..28 (on 32px canvas), face RIGHT, glove at LEFT. Do not draw any Robotnik or hedgehog fragments. Preserve turning-panel perspective, no dither noise.
s1-spin1.reduction: alpha>=128 bounding box; Lanczos to native composition rectangle; nearest fixed palette; inside one-pixel outline; portrait lower strip compressed into mapped 24px piece
